label: Marketing Team
blurb: A CMO and five specialists who plan and run your marketing
purpose: For a small business that needs marketing done properly but cannot hire a department. The CMO sets the plan and budget; the specialists create content, win search traffic, draft social posts and emails for approval, and make the visuals.

project.name: Marketing
project.goal: Grow qualified leads and sales with a clear ninety-day marketing plan.

members.title: Chief Marketing Officer
members.name: Maya
focus: Own the ninety-day plan and the weekly marketing review.

avatar.attire: charcoal blazer over a cream top

members.title: Content Writer
members.name: Theo
focus: Write the articles and guides in the plan, one a week to start.

members.title: SEO Specialist
members.name: Amara
focus: Find the searches worth winning and brief the content writer on them.

avatar.attire: mustard cardigan over a white tee
